slides.headline:
What to say
in your first
*5s group chat*

slides.title: The *intro*
slides.body: “Hi all, I'm new in Cape Town. Happy to play anywhere, any position.”

slides.title: The *yes*
slides.body: “I'm in for Thursday. See you at 18:20.” A time beats a thumbs-up.

slides.title: The *honest out*
slides.body: “Can't make it, sorry. Telling you now so you can fill it.” Before 12:00, not at 17:00.

slides.title: The *after*
slides.body: “Good game, lads. Same time next week?” This is how you become a regular.

slides.headline:
Say these four.
You're a
*regular*.
slides.body: Free 5-a-side games in Cape Town, opening area by area.
